auth.signInLead: Sign in to pick up where you left off.
auth.signUpLead: Free, and ready in under a minute.
auth.name: What should Oya call you?
auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short phrase works well.
auth.terms: I agree to Oya's terms and privacy notice (draft until launch).
auth.forgotPassword: Forgot your password? Password resets are coming soon. For now, message the Oya team.
auth.under18Title: Oya isn't available for under-18s yet
auth.under18Body: We can't create an account for you yet, and we haven't kept anything you typed. If you need help right now, these numbers work for everyone.

app.lead: This is where your requests will live. Asking Oya arrives in the next update.
app.emptyBody: When you ask Oya for something, it shows up here with every step.

settings.title: Settings
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. We signed you out everywhere else.
settings.signedOutOthers: Signed out of {count, plural, one {# other device} other {# other devices}}.
settings.twoFactorOn: On. You'll enter a code from your authenticator app when you open the ops console.
settings.twoFactorStaffOnly: Two-factor sign-in is required for Oya staff accounts.

ops.title: Ops console
ops.lead: The queue, task inspector and provider tools arrive in later milestones.
ops.verifyLead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
ops.enrolLead: Ops accounts need a second step at sign-in. Scan this code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
ops.enrolManual: Can't scan? Enter this key in the app instead:
ops.queueLead: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing open.} one {# open item, most urgent first.} other {# open items, most urgent first.}}
ops.selfHarmItem: Safety event (self-harm support shown). Text is admin-only.

emergency.title: Emergency help
emergency.lead: If someone is in danger or badly hurt, call now. Don't wait for a reply from Oya.
emergency.call112Detail: Free on every network in Nigeria. Police, fire and ambulance.
emergency.notADoctor: Oya can't give medical advice or tell you how serious something is. Emergency services can.
emergency.selfHarm: If you're thinking about ending your life or hurting yourself, call 112 now, or go to the nearest hospital emergency unit. You don't have to go through this alone.
emergency.localNumbersPending: Local ambulance numbers for Akwa Ibom will appear here once our team has called each one to confirm it works.
emergency.worksOffline: This page works without data once you've opened it before.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.message: Your message will not be sent. We've kept what you typed.

chat.emptyLead: Say what you need. Oya sorts it.
chat.failed: That didn't go through. Please try again. For emergencies, call 112.
chat.offline: You're offline. Your message will not be sent. Your draft is kept.
chat.offlineBanner: You're offline. Emergency numbers still work.
chat.supportLinesPending: Support line numbers are being checked by our team. If you are in danger, call 112.
chat.staleGuide: This guide is due for a re-check. Confirm fees on the official site.
